policy: Round-robin by task; follow the complete frozen source ranking; stop a task on its first semantic-supported controlled native failure. Independent truth never affects selection or stopping.

validation.independent_source_review: No blocking issues found; not a crash-durability/fsync guarantee.

scope: An incremental admission experiment over the immutable generated pool; not a fresh generation or patch-repair/hidden-test run.
caps: Will be frozen explicitly against remaining research budget before use; implementation defaults are not experimental settings.
